package nats_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	natsadapter "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
)

func TestPublisherRejectsSubjectsOutsideTeacherNamespace(t *testing.T) {
	publisher := &natsadapter.Publisher{
		URL:            "nats://127.0.0.1:1",
		Name:           "test-publisher",
		ConnectTimeout: time.Millisecond,
	}
	err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
		Subject: "student.mastery.updated",
		Payload: []byte(`{"event_id":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003"}`),
	})
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid teacher integration event")
}

func TestPublisherRejectsInvalidEnvelopeBeforeConnecting(t *testing.T) {
	publisher := &natsadapter.Publisher{
		URL:            "nats://127.0.0.1:1",
		Name:           "test-publisher",
		ConnectTimeout: time.Millisecond,
	}
	err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
		Subject: domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded,
		Payload: []byte(`not-json`),
	})
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid teacher integration event")
}
